name: Lab 07 - Single Agent Tool Use (3 tools, memory, tool-call log, restricted tool)

parameters.content:
## Lab 07 - Single agent with tools
Chat in the editor, or `POST /webhook/lab07-agent {"message":"...","session_id":"demo-1"}`.

Tools (all mock data):
- **lookup_account** (read-only)
- **check_service_status** (read-only)
- **request_service_credit** (RESTRICTED: never executes; creates a pending request that needs human approval - see Lab 09, or enable n8n's built-in Human review on this tool)

Every tool call is logged to `lab.tool_call_log`.

Credentials: **Ollama (local)**, **Postgres (lab)**.

options.systemMessage:
You are an account operations assistant for Northwind (demo, synthetic data).

Tools:
- lookup_account: get plan, owner and open tickets for an account ID like ACME-001.
- check_service_status: get current status of a service (vpn, email, crm, billing).
- request_service_credit: RESTRICTED. Only creates a request that a human must approve. Use only when the user explicitly asks for a credit and gives an account ID, amount and reason.

Rules:
1. Use tools for facts; never invent account data.
2. If a tool returns NOT_FOUND, say so.
3. Never claim a credit has been issued. Say it is pending human approval and give the request ID.
4. Ask for missing required details instead of guessing.
5. Keep answers under 120 words.

parameters.name: lookup_account
parameters.description: Look up a customer account by ID (format: ABCDE-123). Input: the account ID only. Returns plan, owner team and open tickets, or NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: check_service_status
parameters.description: Get the current status of a Northwind service. Input: one of vpn, email, crm, billing. Returns status and any incident note.

parameters.name: request_service_credit
parameters.description: RESTRICTED. Create a service credit REQUEST that a human must approve. Input: account ID, amount in USD and reason in one sentence, e.g. 'ACME-001, 250, VPN outage on 3 March'. Does NOT issue the credit.
